coordinate_system.notes: Root frame is the base plate lower-face center. +X points from motor shaft axis to output shaft axis. +Y is lateral span direction in the base plane. +Z is up, shaft axis direction, and pulley/belt width direction.

extensions.handoff_note: Generate low-detail layout CAD first. Do not detail supplier body contours until the proceed gate is approved.

downstream_handoff.notes: Preserve vertical motor/output shaft axes, 70 mm center distance, shared GT2 belt mid-plane, NEMA 17 and 608 interfaces, and M3 patterns. Stop if final sourced geometry changes a locked fact.
downstream_handoff.repair_loop: Use the smallest source/parameter/datum change, regenerate affected artifacts, rerun failed checks, and return to proceed gate if any locked fact must change.
stop_conditions: Stop if a locked axis, locked center distance, locked belt mid-plane, locked mounting pattern, locked bearing interface, or locked drivetrain ratio must change.
Stop if sourced standard part geometry cannot preserve the locked layout facts.
Stop if motor shaft length or pulley hub geometry invalidates the approved belt mid-plane.

extensions.architecture: Vertical parallel-shaft belt-drive module with motor below base plate and pulleys above plate.

inspection_plan.expected: Root frame is base plate lower-face center, XY base plane, +Z up.
Motor shaft axis is +Z at X=-35 mm, Y=0 mm and is coaxial with the motor GT2 pulley.
Output shaft, 608 bearing bore, and output pulley bore are coaxial at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm, direction +Z.
Distance between motor shaft axis and output shaft axis is 70 mm.
Motor pulley pitch plane, output pulley pitch plane, and GT2 belt centerline all lie at Z=13.5 mm.
Motor fastener axes form a 31 mm square pattern centered on the NEMA 17 shaft axis with M3 clearance diameter.
608 bearing interface preserves 8 mm bore, 22 mm OD, 7 mm width, and coaxial bore/shaft axis.
GT2 belt/pulley interface preserves 2 mm pitch, 6 mm belt width, 20T/20T pitch references, and 1:1 ratio.
Source-lock evidence documents exist for motor, motor pulley, output pulley, 608 bearing, 8 mm shaft, and M3 fasteners.

parts.local_frame: motor_frame: shaft axis +Z at X=-35 mm, Y=0 mm; front face flush to base_plate_bottom_plane; body extends -Z.
parts.proxy_policy: NEMA 17 box envelope with shaft axis and 31 mm mounting pattern; connector and exact length simplified.

parts.local_frame: motor_pulley_frame: bore axis +Z coaxial with motor shaft, pitch plane XY at Z=13.5 mm, 20T pitch reference.
parts.proxy_policy: smooth pulley pitch cylinder and belt pitch plane; teeth, flanges, hub, and set screws simplified.

parts.local_frame: output_shaft_frame: shaft axis +Z at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm, crossing belt mid-plane at Z=13.5 mm.
parts.proxy_policy: 8 mm diameter shaft cylinder envelope; end retention, flats, and finish simplified.

parts.local_frame: output_pulley_frame: bore axis +Z coaxial with output shaft, pitch plane XY at Z=13.5 mm, 20T pitch reference.
parts.proxy_policy: smooth pulley pitch cylinder and 8 mm bore axis; teeth, flanges, hub, and set screws simplified.

parts.local_frame: bearing_frame: bearing bore axis +Z coaxial with output shaft at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm; seated in support block.
parts.proxy_policy: 608 bearing cylindrical envelope preserving 8 mm bore, 22 mm OD, and 7 mm width.

parts.local_frame: support_block_frame: origin at output shaft axis on top face of base plate; bearing pocket axis +Z.
parts.proxy_policy: custom support block envelope with 608 bearing seat and M3 fastener axes; fillets and retainer details simplified.

parts.local_frame: belt_frame: belt centerline in XY plane at Z=13.5 mm, tangent to both pulley pitch circles.
parts.proxy_policy: belt mid-plane and width envelope only; tooth shape and belt thickness simplified.

parts.local_frame: motor_fastener_pattern_frame: four +Z axes on 31 mm square centered at X=-35 mm, Y=0 mm.
parts.proxy_policy: clearance axes and pattern only; screw heads and threads simplified.

parts.local_frame: support_fastener_pattern_frame: four +Z axes around bearing support block, centered at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm.
parts.proxy_policy: clearance axes and pattern only; screw heads and threads simplified.

connections.statement: NEMA 17 motor is fixed to the base plate using four M3 fastener axes on a 31 mm square pattern centered on the motor shaft.
Motor pulley bore and pitch circle are coaxial with the NEMA 17 motor shaft axis.
608 bearing outer race is centered in the support block bearing seat.
Output shaft, 608 bearing bore, and output pulley bore share the same +Z axis.
GT2 belt centerline is tangent to both pulley pitch circles in the shared belt mid-plane.
Bearing support block is fixed to the top of the base plate by M3 fastener axes outside the belt keep-out.

contacts.statement: NEMA 17 front mounting face is flush to the base plate bottom datum plane.
Bearing support block bottom face is flush to the base plate top datum plane.
Belt width envelope plus 2 mm lateral clearance remains clear of support and fastener head envelopes.

motion.statement: Motor pulley rotates about the NEMA 17 shaft axis with the motor rotor.
Output shaft and output pulley rotate about the 608 bearing bore axis.
Equal 20T GT2 pulleys transmit motor rotation to output shaft at 1:1 ratio.

root_frame.axes: +X motor-to-output shaft, +Y lateral span direction in the base plane, +Z up, shaft axis direction, and pulley/belt width direction
root_frame.notes: Vertical parallel-shaft architecture with motor below the base plate and pulleys above it.

locked_layout_facts.statement: base_plate_frame uses XY base plane, +Z up, origin at base lower-face center.
Motor shaft axis, output shaft axis, and bearing bore axis are parallel to +Z.
Motor shaft axis and output shaft axis are 70 mm apart along +X.
Motor shaft axis is located at X=-35 mm, Y=0 mm in the root frame.
Output shaft and bearing axis is located at X=35 mm, Y=0 mm in the root frame.
Motor pulley pitch plane, output pulley pitch plane, and belt centerline are all in the XY plane at Z=13.5 mm.
NEMA 17 motor fastener axes form a 31 mm square pattern centered on the motor shaft axis.
608 bearing interface preserves 8 mm bore, 22 mm OD, and 7 mm axial width.
Output shaft nominal diameter is 8 mm and is coaxial with the bearing bore and output pulley bore.
GT2 pitch is 2 mm, belt width is 6 mm, both pulleys are 20T, and the drive ratio is 1:1.
M3 layout clearance diameter is 3.4 mm for motor and bearing support fastener axes.

blocked_by: Final detail CAD must confirm exact motor shaft length, pulley hub geometry, 608 bearing fit class, shaft retention, belt length, and tensioning method.
proceed_gate.required_user_decision: Review the vertical parallel-shaft layout. Approve the shaft orientation, 70 mm center distance, 13.5 mm belt mid-plane, NEMA 17 mount, 608 bearing support, GT2 pulley pair, and belt path before detail modeling.

repair_loop.locked_fact_change_policy: Return to proceed gate if any locked axis, center distance, belt mid-plane, mounting pattern, bearing interface, shaft interface, or GT2 drivetrain relationship must change.
repair_loop.notes: Change the smallest responsible source, parameter, datum, or relationship; regenerate the affected artifact; rerun failed and dependent checks.
